races.paceDynamic: My Mate Alfie will take the field along from the front with minimal pressure, creating a sustainable early tempo that should suit the large contingent of hold-up horses. With Art Power, Super Soldier and Myal likely to race prominently behind the leader, the pace will be genuine but not destructive. This setup creates a tactical race where the numerous closers like Spycatcher, Montassib, Annaf and Jasour will need to find racing room in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If My Mate Alfie maintains a strong gallop and the prominent horses keep honest pressure
scenarios.body: The pace stays solid from halfway, preventing the field from bunching and creating a true-run race. Hold-up horses with the best turn of foot will have their chance but need to be produced at the right moment.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Slow Early Messy Finish
scenarios.trigger: If My Mate Alfie goes too slow early and the prominent horses fail to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole with a bunched field and traffic problems. Horses with tactical speed and clean runs will prevail over pure closers caught behind horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses put unexpected pressure on My Mate Alfie from halfway
scenarios.body: The early leaders tire badly in the soft ground, setting up the race perfectly for the strongest finishers. Pure hold-up horses with stamina will come through late to collar the weakening pace-setters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If My Mate Alfie gets loose on the lead and the soft ground blunts finishing kicks
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while the hold-up horses struggle to make inroads on the testing surface. Prominent racers with stamina reserves will chase home the winner.

races.paceDynamic: First Ambition is the sole confirmed front-runner and will likely get an uncontested lead with the prominent runners Mezcala, Cadarn, Empirestateofmind, Milteye and Pressure's On settling just behind. This creates a sustainable pace that heavily favours the 16 hold-up horses who can sit and sprint, turning this into a tactical affair where the strongest finishers from the pack will dominate.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and the field bunches up approaching the final 2f
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the strongest hold-up horses to get perfect positioning. Sterling Knight, Far From Dandy and Desperate Dan can unleash their superior ratings from ideal spots.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent horse survives
scenarios.trigger: If First Ambition gets a soft lead and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: The front group maintains their advantage as the pack struggles to organize. Mezcala or Empirestateofmind can capitalize on their forward positions with their decent ratings.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Soft ground specialist strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the going deteriorates further and affects the higher-rated horses
scenarios.body: Horses with proven soft/heavy form gain significant advantages over those unproven on testing ground. On The River and Lir Speciale can exploit their strong wet weather records.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Field spreads and crawls
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes extremely slow and creates a blanket finish sprint
scenarios.body: The large field compresses into a cavalry charge where anything can happen. Rainbow Nebula or Vincent Rocks could benefit from the chaos with their recent winning form.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Volterra and Excellent Believe engage in a sustained duel through the first half-mile
scenarios.body: The pace will string out the field and favor horses with stamina reserves over pure speed. Docklands gets the strong gallop he needs while the leaders weaken in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Volterra Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Volterra gets first run and dictates a more measured pace than expected
scenarios.body: The front-runner can conserve energy and kick clear when the field comes under pressure. Excellent Believe tracks closest but lacks the class edge needed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If neither leader commits fully early and the pace becomes stop-start
scenarios.body: The lack of consistent gallop will favor the more tactical runners who can quicken off a slower tempo. Qirat's class tells while Docklands struggles to get into the race from too far back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Excellent Believe Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Excellent Believe jumps fastest and gets an uncontested lead with Volterra slow away
scenarios.body: The front-runner can dictate throughout and hold off late challenges on ground that suits. Recent heavy ground form gives confidence in these conditions.

watchPoints.text: Volterra breaking slowly would leave Excellent Believe with an uncontested lead and dangerous winning chance.
Docklands needs to be positioned closer than usual given the small field and potential for steady early pace.
Qirat's early position will indicate connections' confidence after the disappointing Newmarket run.
The pace battle between the two leaders could set up the race for Docklands if both go too hard early.
Treble Tee's ability to track the right horse early will determine whether he can outrun his rating again.

races.paceDynamic: Valenday is the only confirmed front runner and will lead uncontested from the gates, setting a controlled gallop that won't tire him. With multiple hold-up horses including Turty Tree, Three No Trumps and Sailor Song needing to find room late, plus three unknown newcomers, this shapes as a race where tactical positioning will be crucial as the field compresses in the home straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Valenday maintains his sustainable pace without being challenged early
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows him to dictate terms throughout and kick clear when asked. The hold-up brigade struggle to make up enough ground on soft ground that favors front runners.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Newcomers Show Early Speed
scenarios.trigger: If one or more of the three unraced horses (Marasi Bay, Rebel Legend, Super Crown) press Valenday early
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and sets up a stronger finish for the closers. Valenday's tank empties in the final furlong under pressure.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Control Race
scenarios.trigger: If Faeberon and High Storm take more prominent positions than usual to avoid traffic
scenarios.body: These two work together to put pressure on Valenday while staying clear of the crowded pack behind. The tactical switch pays dividends as they have first run on the leaders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic-Free Hold-Up Win
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get clear runs and the pace collapses completely in the final quarter-mile
scenarios.body: Sailor Song and Three No Trumps benefit from their stamina over this longer trip as the early leaders tie up. The soft ground aids their grinding finish style.
